stories.title: Reportan nuevo ataque con “proyectil no identificado” contra el aeropuerto de Riad; provoca incendio en terminal 4

en.title: Report of new 'unidentified projectile' attack against Riyadh airport; causes fire in terminal 4
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport's terminal 4 caused a fire, following reports that a coalition airstrike targeted Sana'a's international airport.

stories.title: Liga MX: Horarios y canales para ver la Jornada 11 del Apertura 2026; HOY, domingo 11 de octubre

en.title: Liga MX: Schedule and channels for Matchday 11 of Apertura 2026; TODAY, Sunday October 11
en.summary: Liga MX matchday 11 fixtures are scheduled for Sunday with only the Pumas versus Cruz Azul match being broadcast on open television.

stories.title: Muere hombre tras ataque de tigre en zoológico británico

en.title: Man dies following tiger attack at British zoo
en.summary: A man died after entering a tiger enclosure and being attacked by a tiger at a United Kingdom zoo, according to authorities.

stories.title: Reportan que nuevo proyectil impactó en Aeropuerto de Arabia

en.title: Report that new projectile impacted Saudi Arabia Airport
en.summary: A new projectile struck a passenger terminal at Riyadh Airport, according to the Saudi-led coalition fighting Houthi forces.

stories.title: Rusia y Ucrania acuerdan cese al fuego energético, afirma Trump; ¡No lo rompan!

en.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire, Trump claims; Don't break it!
en.summary: Donald Trump stated that Russia and Ukraine have reached an agreement to refrain from attacking each other's energy infrastructure.

en.title: Liga MX: What time and where to watch Sunday, October 11 matches from Matchday 11?
en.summary: Pumas face Cruz Azul in a featured match concluding Matchday 11 of the 2026 Apertura season, with América leading and Querétaro in third place.

stories.title: Operarán a Papa León XIV para extirparle nódulo en un pulmón

en.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo surgery to remove lung nodule
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV announced he will have surgery in the coming days to remove a recently discovered nodule in his lung.

stories.title: Huracán Simon categoría 4 amenaza a Jalisco y Colima con lluvias extraordinarias y torrenciales este domingo

en.title: Hurricane Simon Category 4 threatens Jalisco and Colima with extraordinary and torrential rains this Sunday
en.summary: Hurricane Simon approaches the coasts of Colima and Jalisco with winds reaching 240 km/h, bringing warnings of extreme rainfall, waves up to 10 meters high, and flooding risk.

stories.title: Papa León XIV anuncia que se realizará operación; tiene un nódulo en el pulmón en "fase inicial", explica

en.title: Pope Leo XIV announces he will undergo surgery; has lung nodule in "initial phase", he explains
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV will undergo surgery in the coming days for a lung nodule in its initial stage, requiring a postoperative recovery period.

stories.title: Huracán Simon se acerca a la costa de Jalisco como categoría 4: SMN

en.title: Hurricane Simon approaches Jalisco coast as Category 4: SMN
en.summary: Hurricane Simon was maintaining Category 4 strength and was expected to make landfall on Jalisco's coast this morning in the municipalities of Tomatlán and La Huerta, according to Mexico's National Meteorological Service coordinator.

stories.title: Campaña de Lula denuncia a Meta por interferencia electoral en Brasil

en.title: Lula's campaign accuses Meta of electoral interference in Brazil
en.summary: Brazil's president and reelection candidate Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign filed a complaint alleging Meta interfered in the election by blocking his content promotion on Instagram and disrupting his account's reach.

stories.title: Golpea huracán Isaías sureste de EU: 4 muertos; deja sin energía a 670 mil

en.title: Hurricane Isaías strikes US Southeast: 4 dead; leaves 670,000 without power
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías made landfall in the United States killing four people, and approximately 670,000 residents across Florida, Alabama, Georgia, and Mississippi remained without electricity after the storm weakened into a tropical cyclone.

stories.title: Nerds llega oficialmente a México tras años de venta por distribuidores

en.title: Nerds officially arrives in Mexico after years of distributor sales
en.summary: Ferrara Candy Company's Nerds brand launched official operations in Mexico with a strategy combining diverse product formats and marketing activations to build consumer presence.

stories.title: Mantendrá México de las inflaciones médicas más altas en América Latina en 2027

en.title: Mexico to Maintain One of the Highest Medical Inflation Rates in Latin America in 2027
en.summary: Mexico is projected to have one of the highest medical inflation rates in Latin America in 2027, with increases far exceeding general inflation, though at a slower pace than 2026, continuing pressure on business and household budgets.
